properties.traced_from: Baron Eduard von Toll's account of his sighting on 13 August 1886: no drawing found
properties.scale_source: Toll, 'Proposal for an Expedition to Sannikoff Land', Geographical Journal 12 (August 1898), pp. 162-163: from the mouth of the Mogur on Kotelny he saw, N 14-18 E, 'the sharp outlines of four truncated cones like table mountains, from which a low foreland extended towards the east', about 200 km off, and the mountains 'ought to have been marked on the map due north of the northern extremity of Kotelnyi island'. 4 degrees of arc at 200 km: the mountains span 14 km. The foreland's length (20 km) and the shore line are invented; only a south shore, since only that was seen
liberties: the shore line: only a profile was ever seen, and no drawing found
